investigations.title: Authentication Alert Investigation
questions: Which statement is established by the records?
One successful login with MFA passed
The attacker stole a password
A data breach occurred
The log records success with MFA; it cannot identify the person's intent.
What detail needs validation before escalation?
Whether the source and report access were expected for Maya
The page's button styling
The office's wallpaper
Compare with authorized account ownership and expected activity.
Why is the download event not sufficient proof of exfiltration?
It records an allowed action, not unauthorized motive or destination
Every download is harmless
The MFA record erases all risk
Outcome and context determine whether an action is suspicious.
What should the written finding distinguish?
Verified events, unknowns and recommended checks
Assumptions presented as facts
Private credentials
Evidence-based reporting preserves uncertainty.
What is the best immediate action with no other indicators?
Continue scoped verification and record the timeline
Disable all organizational accounts
Publish the user's records
Proportionate investigation avoids needless disruption.

investigations.title: DNS and Connectivity Triage
evidence: Wi-Fi association: connected; DHCP lease: valid
Other approved site by IP: reachable
questions: Which component best matches the failure?
Name resolution
Local Wi-Fi association
Device display
A working local gateway and IP reachability make DNS a sensible next check.
Does the evidence prove an attacker changed DNS?
No
Yes
Only if the laptop is old
A DNS failure has multiple potential causes.
What is a low-impact next action?
Check approved resolver configuration and compare with another controlled device
Reset every router
Disable all firewalls
Start with reversible checks.
What would be useful in an escalation ticket?
Address settings, error, timeline, tests and scope
Unrelated passwords
Only the word broken
Clear observed evidence enables repeatable diagnosis.
What verifies a DNS fix?
Expected hostname resolves and the application works again
The screen color changes
A user guesses it is fixed
Verify both name resolution and the original task.

investigations.title: Shared Folder Access Review
evidence: Policy: finance editors may modify; interns may view approved reports only
Observed: intern account assigned finance-editors group
Recent audit: no file changes confirmed
questions: Which issue is confirmed?
An intern has excessive group membership
Files were stolen
Every intern altered reports
The membership violates the described role policy.
What would be unsupported?
Claiming proven data theft
Reporting the access mismatch
Requesting review by the owner
No file changes are confirmed and read events are not fully described.
What is the least-disruptive corrective direction?
Review and remove unnecessary edit membership with approval
Delete finance reports
Share the admin password
Align permissions to approved duties.
What evidence should be preserved?
Membership and policy details with minimal identifying data
All payroll records
Every employee password
Document configuration without collecting unrelated data.
How is closure verified?
Review resulting effective access with an authorized test account
Assume a ticket closure is enough
Wait indefinitely
Check actual permissions after the change.

investigations.title: Cloud Storage Exposure Review
evidence: Declared intent: public examples; private student submissions
Policy review: broad read grant on bucket root
No real files are present in this simulation
questions: What risk should be escalated?
Private submissions may inherit broad read access
The cloud provider has definitely been breached
Public examples must never exist
The policy may conflict with the privacy classification.
What should be checked before concluding exposure occurred?
Effective permissions and object placement in the authorized lab
An unrelated website
The app's icon
Configuration implications require scoped verification.
What is an appropriate design change?
Separate public content from private records and enforce least privilege
Expose all files for convenience
Remove audit logging
Distinct data classes benefit from separate permission boundaries.
How should evidence be collected?
Use synthetic objects and authorized configuration views
Download real student submissions
Publicly publish private names
Synthetic proof avoids unnecessary data access.
What is a reasonable final report?
Observed grant, potential impact, tested controls and limitations
A guaranteed claim of criminal access
No remediation plan
A defensible report explains both evidence and uncertainty.
